about_the_game:
Zet Zillions is a story-driven roguelike deckbuilder where you will navigate through vast space maps with Foam Gun and her planet-ship Baby Violence, in search of a new home for humanity. Create chaos with the unique fusion system, with more than 100 possible combinations to discover. Overpopulate planets (by throwing your own crew at them) and blow them into smithereens!





With easy onboarding and engaging mechanics, Zet Zillions wastes no time throwing you into action. Think ten steps ahead, strategize carefully but boldly, and find the best tactical approach to defeat COLOSSAL enemies.



Build not one, but many mega decks and strategies on-the-go. Master the fusion system to combine your cards, revealing new, spectacular effects…. Or embarrassing bluffs. There are more than 100 combinations available, and some may not go as well as others. Hey, no risk no glory, amirite?



Traverse randomly generated galaxies and visit thrilling locations. Scavenge abandoned shuttles, discover hidden portals, and meet tons of characters while embarking on side quests. Oh, and don’t forget to make good use of your pineapples.

…Pineapples, yes. Why that face?






Wolfstride is one of the “best games from 20xx” you missed, “hidden gems you need to play before you die” and all that. It is also the previous game by Ota Imon, the studio behind Zet Zillions.

You don't need to play Wolfstride to enjoy Zet Zillions, but if you want extra credit* (and extra FUN), we recommend you give it a try, as you'll learn more about Zet Zillion's universe.

*Credit can be redeemed on our social media, where we will compliment you and tell you that you are very cool.'
